main_text.p: חכיבתא Ch. Socrus, Deut.27.23. in T. Hierof.
מנבכין Syr. Sarmenta, Act.28.3. Tremell.reddit, Ramos.
ܩܠܐ Syr. Stipula, sic dicta, quòd facilè Accenda-tur, aut quòd proprium ejus eft Comburi, i. ad Corinth.3.12.
חבט Ch. Concutere, decutere, excutere, percutere. Sic Syr. cum Aff. ܐܪܟܒ Concutit eū, vel profternit. Græc. ἐαπάρξα, sic v.18. ܡܪܟܒ pro Græc. ῥήσσει. Pahel חבט Idem.

חבל Pahel Ch. & Syr. Corrumpere, destruere, perdere, lædere, ut Hebr. Ponitur quoque Levit. 21.5. pro Hebræo שרט Cædere, incidere. Syris præterea eft Parturire, ut Hebr. ad Gal.4.19. ad Rom.8. 22. Ithpahel אִתְחַבַּל, ܐܬܚܒܠ Corrumpi, perdi, destrui, vastari. Part. ܡܬܚܒܠ Quod corrūpitur, vel corrumpi poteft, corruptibile: præced. ܠܐ, Incorruptibile.
חבולה Ch. Perditum, corruptum, corruptela, lædio. Daniel.6.22.
חבלא, חבל Ch. & Syr. Corruptio, perditio, exilium, damnum, lædio, ܒܠܐ ܠܐ Absque corruptione, incorruptibile, ad Eph.6.24.
חבולא, חבול Ch. Idem, Eccles.7.29. Ezech.9.1. Sed Levit.21.5. respondet Hebræo שרטת Cæsura.

page.notes: Oriental words are partly illegible in the scan; Syriac and Hebrew characters are rendered approximately. The Greek words in v.18 and "ῥήσσει" are doubtful.
